ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pigmentation across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white pixel field across both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels are mapped to a continuous thin band along the trailing edge and a centralized chevron-shaped region at the median notch. Scattered low-intensity circular pixel clusters (spots) are visible in the central and right-mid sections.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern consisting of alternating peaks and valleys. A prominent jagged indentation is located on the inner-left lobe boundary adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch transitioning into a convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white, three-dimensional pixel groups (barnacles) located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes. Several small, dark circular spots of pigmentation are distributed across the central white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible colonization by sessile barnacles at the fluke tips. Multiple shallow surface indentations or dimples are visible across the white field, suggesting healed traumatic contact or previous parasite attachment points.
